sections.title: Day 18 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天接續 Day 17，Listening 正式升級到 **Part 3 三人對話 + 多資訊定位**；文法進入很容易「看起來簡單、實際失分」的 **主詞動詞一致**：`either / neither / along with / as well as / there is / there are`。

因目前沒有新的小考作答紀錄，今天維持 **860～900 分難度**。建議訓練 **90～100 分鐘**，其中 Listening 約 30 分鐘、Reading 25 分鐘、文法與單字 25 分鐘、錯題回收 15 分鐘。

sections.title: ① 今日單字｜30 個
sections.markdown:
主題：**Office Facilities / Maintenance / Equipment**

| 單字 | 中文 | TOEIC 高頻搭配 |
|---|---|---|
| facility | 設施 | office facilities |
| maintenance | 維護 | routine maintenance |
| maintain | 維護 | maintain equipment |
| repair | 維修 | repair equipment |
| renovate | 翻修 | renovate an office |
| renovation | 翻修 | office renovation |

| appliance | 電器 | kitchen appliance |
| machinery | 機械 | heavy machinery |
| install | 安裝 | install equipment |
| installation | 安裝 | installation service |
| inspect | 檢查 | inspect a building |
| inspection | 檢查 | safety inspection |
| replace | 更換 | replace a part |
| replacement | 替換品 | replacement part |
| malfunction | 故障 | equipment malfunction |
| operate | 運作 | operate properly |
| technician | 技術人員 | repair technician |
| contractor | 承包商 | construction contractor |
| entrance | 入口 | main entrance |
| elevator | 電梯 | take the elevator |
| staircase | 樓梯 | emergency staircase |
| lobby | 大廳 | building lobby |
| parking | 停車 | parking area |
| access | 進入；使用權 | building access |
| temporarily | 暫時地 | temporarily unavailable |
| available | 可使用的 | currently available |
| relocate | 搬遷 | relocate employees |
| inconvenience | 不便 | cause inconvenience |
| schedule | 安排 | maintenance schedule |

今天優先記：

**routine maintenance / office renovation / replacement part / equipment malfunction / safety inspection / repair technician / main entrance / building access / temporarily unavailable / maintenance schedule**

注意：

> equipment

是**不可數名詞**。

所以：

> new equipment ✅

> several pieces of equipment ✅

> equipments ❌

這也回收 Day 16 的可數／不可數概念。

---

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜主詞動詞一致
sections.markdown:
最基本：

> The employee **works** here.

> The employees **work** here.

但 TOEIC 不會一直考這麼簡單。

它會把真正主詞藏起來。

例如：

> The manager, along with several employees, _____ attending the conference.

(A) are  
(B) is

真正主詞：

> **The manager**

所以：

> **is**

中間的：

> along with several employees

不改變主詞單複數。

---

sections.title: ③ along with / as well as
sections.markdown:
看到：

> A **along with** B

動詞跟：

> **A**

例如：

> The director, along with two managers, **is** attending.

不是：

> are attending ❌

同樣：

> A **as well as** B

例如：

> The new policy, as well as several updated procedures, **has** been announced.

真正主詞：

> policy

所以：

> **has**

---

sections.title: ④ either / neither
sections.markdown:
單獨使用時通常視為單數。

> Either **is** acceptable.

> Neither **has** been approved.

例如：

> Neither of the proposals _____ suitable.

(A) are  
(B) is

TOEIC 標準考法：

> **is**

---

sections.title: ⑤ either...or / neither...nor
sections.markdown:
這時不完全一樣。

通常動詞配合：

> **離動詞最近的主詞**

例如：

> Either the manager or the employees **are** attending.

最近：

> employees

所以：

> are

但是：

> Either the employees or the manager **is** attending.

最近：

> manager

所以：

> is

這就是：

**proximity rule 就近一致**

---

sections.title: ⑥ there is / there are
sections.markdown:
不要看到：

> There

就判斷單複數。

真正主詞在後面。

> There **is** a problem.

> There **are** several problems.

例如：

> There _____ several documents on your desk.

答案：

> **are**

---

sections.title: ⑦ 860+ 混合陷阱
sections.markdown:
> There _____ a laptop and several documents on the desk.

在正式商務英文與測驗中，通常依最接近動詞的第一個名詞：

> a laptop

因此：

> **There is a laptop...**

但這種結構實際使用上有變異，TOEIC 更常給沒有爭議的：

> There are several documents...

所以解題時優先處理明確題型，不在模糊語法上浪費時間。

---

sections.title: ⑧ Part 3 三人對話策略
sections.markdown:
三人對話最容易發生的問題：

> **知道內容，但不知道是誰說的。**

從今天開始筆記增加角色：

> M1  
> M2  
> W

但不要抄完整句。

例如：

> W → projector broken  
> M1 → call technician  
> M2 → Room B has projector

只記：

**角色 + 關鍵資訊**

---

sections.title: ⑨ Listening｜三人對話 1
sections.markdown:
先讀題。

### Q1

What problem are the speakers discussing?

(A) A meeting has been canceled  
(B) Some equipment is not working  
(C) A report is incomplete  
(D) A customer is late

### Q2

What does the second man suggest?

(A) Contacting a technician  
(B) Moving to another room  
(C) Postponing the presentation  
(D) Buying new equipment

### Q3

What will the woman probably do next?

(A) Reserve another room  
(B) Cancel the meeting  
(C) Print a report  
(D) Call a customer

聽力稿：

> **Woman:** I just tested the projector in Conference Room A, and it isn't turning on. Our presentation starts in forty minutes.
>
> **Man 1:** I'll call the maintenance department. Maybe they can send a technician.
>
> **Man 2:** That might take a while. Conference Room C has the same type of projector, and I don't think anyone is using that room this morning.
>
> **Woman:** Good idea. I'll check the room schedule now.

答案：

**1B / 2B / 3A**

注意 M2 沒直接說：

> Let's move.

他說：

> Room C has the same projector...

真正意圖：

**建議換會議室。**

---

sections.title: ⑩ Listening｜三人對話 2
sections.markdown:
### Q1

Where most likely are the speakers?

(A) At a restaurant  
(B) In an office building  
(C) At an airport  
(D) At a factory

### Q2

What change does the woman mention?

(A) An elevator will be unavailable  
(B) The office will close  
(C) Parking fees will increase  
(D) Employees will relocate permanently

### Q3

What does Man 2 imply?

(A) He plans to work from home  
(B) Another elevator can be used  
(C) Maintenance has been canceled  
(D) The meeting will be postponed

聽力稿：

> **Woman:** Just a reminder—the west elevator will be unavailable tomorrow while the maintenance team replaces some parts.
>
> **Man 1:** That's the elevator closest to our department. How long will the work take?
>
> **Woman:** They expect to finish by four.
>
> **Man 2:** Well, the east elevator is only about a two-minute walk from our offices.
>
> **Woman:** Right. I'll include directions to it in the staff notice.

答案：

**1B / 2A / 3B**

M2 的字面意思：

> 東側電梯只多走兩分鐘。

真正意圖：

> **可以改搭東側電梯。**

---

sections.title: ⑪ Listening｜三人對話 3
sections.markdown:
### Q1

What are the speakers preparing for?

(A) A safety inspection  
(B) A job interview  
(C) A customer survey  
(D) A product launch

### Q2

What still needs to be done?

(A) Equipment must be purchased  
(B) A hallway must be cleared  
(C) Employees must be hired  
(D) A report must be translated

### Q3

Who will probably handle the task?

(A) The woman  
(B) Man 1  
(C) Man 2  
(D) A customer

聽力稿：

> **Man 1:** The building inspector will be here at ten tomorrow morning. Are we ready?
>
> **Woman:** Almost. I've checked the emergency exits and updated all the safety signs.
>
> **Man 2:** I noticed several boxes in the hallway near the staircase.
>
> **Woman:** Those need to be moved before the inspection.
>
> **Man 1:** I'll ask the facilities team to take care of them this afternoon.

答案：

**1A / 2B / 3B**

最後一題要追角色。

真正採取行動的是：

> **Man 1**

因為：

> I'll ask...

---

sections.title: ⑫ Reading｜Part 7
sections.markdown:
限時：

**3 分 30 秒。**

> **BUILDING MAINTENANCE NOTICE**
>
> Routine maintenance of the elevators in the Parkview Office Center will begin on September 21 and continue through September 23.
>
> During this period, either the east elevator or the west elevator will remain available at all times. Both elevators will not be taken out of service simultaneously.
>
> The west elevator, along with the equipment in its control room, will be inspected on September 21. Maintenance of the east elevator is scheduled for the following day.
>
> There are two emergency staircases in the building. Employees may use them if elevator service becomes temporarily crowded.
>
> On September 23, technicians will test both elevators before normal service resumes. There may be short periods when neither elevator is available during these tests.
>
> Building management apologizes for any inconvenience this work may cause.

### Q1

How long is the maintenance scheduled to last?

(A) One day  
(B) Two days  
(C) Three days  
(D) One week

### Q2

What is indicated about September 21?

(A) Both elevators will be closed  
(B) The west elevator will be inspected  
(C) The east elevator will be replaced  
(D) Normal service will resume

### Q3

What can employees use if elevators become crowded?

(A) Another office building  
(B) Emergency staircases  
(C) A parking elevator  
(D) The control room

### Q4

What is scheduled for September 23?

(A) Elevator testing  
(B) Office relocation  
(C) Safety training  
(D) Construction

### Q5

What might happen during the tests?

(A) Neither elevator may be available briefly  
(B) Employees must leave the building  
(C) Both staircases will close  
(D) Parking will be unavailable

### Q6

In the sentence “The west elevator, along with the equipment in its control room, **will be inspected**,” what is the main subject?

(A) equipment  
(B) control room  
(C) west elevator  
(D) technicians

### Q7

The word **“simultaneously”** is closest in meaning to:

(A) carefully  
(B) separately  
(C) at the same time  
(D) unexpectedly

答案：

**1C / 2B / 3B / 4A / 5A / 6C / 7C**

Q6 就是今天文法直接進入閱讀：

> west elevator, along with...

真正主詞：

**west elevator**

sections.title: ⑮ 今日解析
sections.markdown:
Q1：

> The project manager, **along with several engineers**, _____

先把中間插入資訊遮掉：

> The project manager _____ attending.

單數。

所以：

> **is**

---

Q3：

> Either the supervisor or the technicians _____

看最靠近動詞：

> technicians

複數。

所以：

> **are**

反過來：

> Either the technicians or the supervisor **is**

---

Q5：

> The new equipment, as well as the replacement parts, _____ been inspected.

真正主詞：

> equipment

不可數、視為單數。

所以：

> **has been inspected**

這題同時考：

**主詞動詞一致 + equipment 不可數 + 現在完成被動。**

sections.title: ⑯ 錯題複習｜Day 14～17
sections.markdown:
請直接回答：

> The company changed _____ policy.

**its**

> Employees registered _____.

**themselves**

> Some attended; _____ did not.

**others**

> We have very _____ information.

**little**

> We still have _____ time.

**a little**

> Each of the products _____ inspected.

**is**

> _____ who has questions should contact HR.

**Anyone**

> Everyone _____ required to attend.

**is**

> something _____

**important / useful / unusual 等形容詞**

> We didn't notice _____ unusual.

**anything**

目標：

**10 題 ≤ 40 秒。**

---

sections.title: ⑰ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
單字先集中複習：

> routine maintenance  
> office renovation  
> equipment malfunction  
> replacement part  
> safety inspection  
> repair technician  
> building access  
> temporarily unavailable  
> main entrance  
> maintenance schedule

文法則只背三條核心：

> **A along with / as well as B → 動詞跟 A**

> **either A or B / neither A nor B → 動詞通常跟最近的主詞**

> **there is/are → 看後面的真正主詞**

Listening 作業把三段對話壓成：

> **D1：W projector broken → M1 technician → M2 Room C → W check schedule**

> **D2：W west elevator maintenance → M1 asks duration → M2 east elevator → W notice**

> **D3：inspection → W exits/signs done → M2 boxes → M1 facilities team**

今天特別要求保留 **W / M1 / M2**，因為三人對話最大的風險不是沒聽懂，而是把「誰提出建議、誰採取行動」記錯。

最後重新完成 Day 18 小考，第二次限制 **2 分 15 秒**，目標 **10/10**。

如果今天達到 **9～10/10**，下一階段會把 Listening 提升到更接近 900 分的「三人對話 + 同義改寫 + 多步推論」；若 Q6～Q10 錯兩題以上，則下一天會繼續保留角色追蹤訓練。

**Day 18 核心：三人對話不要試圖記完整內容，只記「誰 → 問題／資訊／行動」。**

Day 19 將進入 **Part 3 圖表資訊整合**，開始訓練「聽到對話中的條件，再到表格中定位答案」；文法則進入 **動名詞與不定詞進階：remember / stop / try 等動詞在 V-ing 與 to V 下的語意差異**。
